title: Monday's market in 14 links: AI chips sold off, Telus received a bid,Molina rose 9%, and a 75% print was an ex-date move
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
A one-page recap of Monday, drawn from today's write-ups: AI chip  
names sold off ahead of Nvidia earnings, Telus received a takeover  
bid, Molina Healthcare rose about 9%, and a startling 75% decline in  
Embraer was an ex-date mechanical print rather than a live crash.  
  
Here are the 14 links.  
  
\*\*1. SanDisk (SNDK)\*\* — SanDisk dropped -7.73%, falling from Friday's  
close of $885.01 to $816.62 during Monday's regular session, extending  
losses that began in premarket trading. The decline is sector-wide:  
memory and storage chip names sold off as investors cut  
AI-semiconductor exposure before Nvidia's November 17 earnings, with  
Jensen Huang's resignation fallout and doubts over data-center  
financing weighing on the whole group.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sandisk-corporation-sndk-stock-down-7-73-today-38762/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sandisk-corporation-sndk-stock-down-7-73-today-38762/)  
  
\*\*2. Credo Technology Group Holding (CRDO)\*\* — CRDO dropped -6.97%  
(-$9.16), falling from Friday's close of $131.51 to $122.35 in early  
regular-session trading on Monday. The decline was driven by a broad  
AI-infrastructure selloff tied to Nvidia's leadership crisis — founder  
Jensen Huang's resignation, board succession turmoil and caution  
before Nvidia's Tuesday results and Anthropic's market debut — with  
peers Intel and AMD each -5.2% premarket.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-credo-technology-group-holding-crdo-stock-down-7-17-today-38739/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-credo-technology-group-holding-crdo-stock-down-7-17-today-38739/)  
  
\*\*3. NVIDIA (NVDA)\*\* — NVIDIA shares declined roughly 26% over the 30  
days ending mid-November, falling from a close near $221 to $162.85.  
The drop left the stock about 30% below its October 6 record intraday  
high of $243.37 and at a 52-week low.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-drops-26-over-30-days-leadership-changes-and-ai-doubts-take-a-toll-38456/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-drops-26-over-30-days-leadership-changes-and-ai-doubts-take-a-toll-38456/)  
  
\*\*4. Marvell Technology (MRVL)\*\* — Marvell Technology (MRVL) shares  
fell roughly 36% over the 30-day period, dropping from about $245 to  
about $157 on a closing basis.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/marvell-technology-mrvl-shares-drop-36-after-lumentum-acquisition-announcement-38451/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/marvell-technology-mrvl-shares-drop-36-after-lumentum-acquisition-announcement-38451/)  
  
\*\*5. TELUS (TU)\*\* — TU jumped +11.14%, climbing from the previous  
close of $8.53 to $9.48 in Monday's regular session, after premarket  
quotes had pointed to an even sharper opening gap higher. The catalyst  
was Québecor's unsolicited, non-binding proposal to acquire TELUS at  
C$19.45 per share, a roughly 60% premium; TELUS confirmed receipt of  
the June 27 offer and a November 9 amendment.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-telus-corporation-tu-stock-up-11-14-today-39141/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-telus-corporation-tu-stock-up-11-14-today-39141/)  
  
\*\*6. Molina Healthcare (MOH)\*\* — Molina Healthcare shares climbed to  
$228.92 from a $209.49 previous close, a +9.27% gain during Monday's  
regular session, as of 3:11 PM ET. The catalyst was regulatory: CMS  
said Friday that states may opt into a "hold harmless" period through  
June 30, 2027 before enforcing new Medicaid work requirements,  
deferring the enrollment losses that threatened Medicaid-focused  
insurers' 2027 revenue.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-molina-healthcare-moh-stock-up-9-27-today-39151/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-molina-healthcare-moh-stock-up-9-27-today-39151/)  
  
\*\*7. CG Oncology (CGON)\*\* — CG Oncology shares rose to $86.02 from  
Friday's $74.40 close, a gain of +$11.62, or +15.62%, with the move  
occurring during Monday's regular session. The catalyst was the 8:00  
a.m. ET release of positive Phase 3 PIVOT-006 topline data: adjuvant  
cretostimogene cut bladder cancer recurrence risk by 68% versus  
control (hazard ratio 0.32, p<0.0001) in intermediate-risk and  
high-grade Ta NMIBC.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-cg-oncology-cgon-stock-up-15-31-today-39124/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-cg-oncology-cgon-stock-up-15-31-today-39124/)  
  
\*\*8. H World Group (HTHT)\*\* — HTHT jumped +8.87%, rising to $54.86  
from Friday's $50.39 close, a +$4.47 move recorded during Monday's  
regular session rather than premarket or after-hours. The catalyst was  
the pre-market Q3 2026 report: earnings of ¥6.23 per ADS beat the  
¥5.41 consensus, revenue of ¥7.75B topped the ¥7.32B estimate, and  
full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance was raised to 9%–10% from  
4%–8%.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-h-world-group-limited-htht-stock-up-8-87-today-39147/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-h-world-group-limited-htht-stock-up-8-87-today-39147/)  
  
\*\*9. FitLife Brands (FTLF)\*\* — FitLife Brands shares dropped from  
Friday's $8.48 close to $6.70, a -20.99% decline, within the first  
hour of Monday's regular session after opening sharply lower. The  
catalyst was the pre-market third-quarter report: EPS of $0.16 missed  
the $0.25 consensus by -36% and revenue of $25.62 million fell short  
of the $26.80 million expected, with adjusted EBITDA down -13% year  
over year.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-fitlife-brands-ftlf-stock-down-20-99-today-38843/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-fitlife-brands-ftlf-stock-down-20-99-today-38843/)  
  
\*\*10. Embraer (EMBJ)\*\* — EMBJ closed Friday at $78.73 and printed  
$19.53 at 9:48 a.m. ET, a -75.19% decline recorded during Monday's  
regular NYSE session. The drop is the ex-date mechanics of Embraer's  
4-for-1 forward ADS split, effective at the open on November 16, which  
changed the ratio from one ADS representing four common shares to one  
ADS representing one share after holders received three additional  
ADSs per ADS.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-embraer-s-a-embj-stock-down-75-19-today-38691/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-embraer-s-a-embj-stock-down-75-19-today-38691/)  
  
\*\*11. Fiserv (FISV)\*\* — Fiserv (FISV) rose roughly 34% over the last  
30 days, rebounding from about $47.55 in mid-October to $63.78 by  
mid-November. The rally was sparked by third-quarter 2026 results,  
when Fiserv doubled its Project Elevate cost-savings target to $1  
billion and announced a $500 million fourth-quarter share buyback.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/fiserv-fisv-shares-climb-34-over-30-days-on-earnings-momentum-38457/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/fiserv-fisv-shares-climb-34-over-30-days-on-earnings-momentum-38457/)  
  
\*\*12. Equinix (EQIX)\*\* — The central price target of $1,230 is the  
arithmetic mean of 25 verified analyst price targets reviewed for this  
article, rounded from roughly $1,232. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/equinix-eqix-can-it-reach-17-upside-to-the-1-230-target-38470/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/equinix-eqix-can-it-reach-17-upside-to-the-1-230-target-38470/)  
  
\*\*13. T-Rex 2X Long DJT Daily Target ETF (DJTU)\*\* — DJTU fell roughly  
\-75% over the last 30 days, reflecting a sharp decline in its single  
underlying stock, Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. The fund's  
three-month trend is even weaker, with the ETF down approximately -83%  
over the quarter.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/t-rex-2x-long-djt-daily-target-etf-djtu-drops-75-in-30-days-as-djt-weakens-sharply-39028/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/t-rex-2x-long-djt-daily-target-etf-djtu-drops-75-in-30-days-as-djt-weakens-sharply-39028/)  
  
\*\*14. Amplify Solana 3% Monthly Option Income ETF (SOLM)\*\* — SOLM  
declined roughly 42% over the past 30 days, falling from about $8.98  
in mid-October to near $5.17. Over the last quarter, the fund lost  
approximately 37% after peaking above $11 in late September.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/amplify-solana-3-monthly-option-income-etf-solm-declines-42-in-past-month-as-solana-retreats-39087/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/amplify-solana-3-monthly-option-income-etf-solm-declines-42-in-past-month-as-solana-retreats-39087/)  
  
Which of today's stories are you actually opening first, and did any  
of these moves surprise you?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 16) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
